calendar.note: Below EUR 112,000 of turnover VAT is declared yearly, before 1 March of the next year (quarterly up to EUR 620,000, by the 15th of the month after the quarter). workdays.note: Not verified whether deadlines here move off weekends and holidays. Kyros shows the last working day on or before the legal date, so paying on it is always in time, and keeps the reserve locked until the next working day after it.

items.label: Income tax, tax class 1 (single), scale in force since 1 January 2025 (art. 118 LIR), plus the 7% employment fund contribution

notes: Tax class 1 (single, no children). Classes 1a and 2 (married or partnered, joint taxation) pay less on the same income. Above EUR 150,000 of taxable income (class 1) the employment fund contribution is 9% instead of 7%; the estimate keeps 7%.
Social contributions are deducted from profit before income tax; the dependency insurance is paid on income with an allowance of a quarter of the minimum wage, not included.
Rates: 17% standard, 14% intermediate, 8% reduced, 3% super-reduced. Income tax is progressive and social contributions apply; 30% is a suggested reserve.
The reserve estimate uses tax class 1. From the 2028 tax year a single tax class (Tarif U) replaces classes 1, 1a and 2 (bill presented on 6 January 2026).
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
